free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports intervention due to the presence of a high-risk PI-RADS 4 lesion and a concerning PSA velocity of 1.1 ng/mL/yr. This finding is important because it contradicts the caution implied by the prior negative biopsy status. The decision is driven by the PI-RADS 4 score and the PSA trend, which together necessitate further tissue sampling.
